commands.name: $psversiontable
commands.notes: PSVersion and GitCommitId report the compatibility profile the session is running, not a real engine build. OS and Platform describe the simulated Ubuntu machine — the same fiction uname and hostname report — and are not your computer.

commands.name: bash
commands.notes: Acknowledges the request and stays in PowerShell. No second shell exists.

commands.name: classic

commands.name: coffee
commands.notes: A joke.

commands.name: copy-item
commands.synopsis: Copy an item to another location (cp)

commands.name: df
commands.notes: Invented disk figures. Real browser storage usage is reported by Get-StorageStatus instead.

commands.name: exit
commands.notes: A browser tab cannot close itself unless it opened itself. This prints a farewell and returns you to the prompt; no session ends.

commands.name: fortune
commands.notes: A joke.

commands.name: free
commands.synopsis: Display amount of free and used memory in the system
commands.notes: Invented memory figures. The browser does not expose host memory.

commands.name: get-content
commands.synopsis: Get the contents of a file (cat/type)

commands.name: get-date
commands.synopsis: Get the current date and time

commands.name: get-history
commands.synopsis: Get the commands entered during the current session

commands.name: get-process
commands.synopsis: Get the processes running on the local computer
commands.notes: Lists invented processes. No host or browser process is enumerated.

commands.name: get-source
commands.synopsis: List every authoritative source, with links

commands.name: git
commands.notes: No repository is read and no git runs. status and remote are fixed text; log renders the portfolio timeline formatted as commits.

commands.name: hostname
commands.notes: The hostname of the simulated machine.

commands.name: ifconfig
commands.notes: Not present until the simulated net-tools package is installed, after which it reports that the call is not implemented. The browser cannot enumerate real network interfaces at all.

commands.name: ip
commands.synopsis: show / manipulate routing, network devices, interfaces and tunnels
commands.notes: Reports an invented interface. The browser cannot enumerate real network interfaces.

commands.name: konami
commands.notes: A joke.

commands.name: lsb_release
commands.notes: Describes the simulated Ubuntu environment, not the machine you are using.

commands.name: matrix
commands.notes: A joke.

commands.name: move-item
commands.synopsis: Move an item to another location (mv)

commands.name: nano
commands.synopsis: Nano's ANOther editor, inspired by Pico

commands.name: new-item
commands.synopsis: Create a new file or directory (mkdir/ni)

commands.name: ping
commands.synopsis: send ICMP ECHO_REQUEST to network hosts
commands.notes: No packet is sent. ICMP is not reachable from a browser; the timings are illustrative.

commands.name: ps
commands.synopsis: report a snapshot of the current processes
commands.notes: Lists invented Unix processes. It does not show this page workers or browser tasks — that is what the kernel process table will report once it exists.

commands.name: reset-filesystem
commands.synopsis: Restore the file system to its initial state

commands.name: rocket
commands.notes: A joke.

commands.name: secret
commands.notes: A joke.

commands.name: select-object
commands.synopsis: Select the first or last N objects

commands.name: set-content
commands.synopsis: Write new content to a file (sc)

commands.name: set-location
commands.notes: Changes the working directory for this session only; the location is not persisted.

commands.name: sl
commands.notes: A joke response to a common typo for ls.

commands.name: sudo
commands.notes: Grants nothing in the browser, the origin, or your computer, and never can. In the v1 terminal it does not even elevate anything virtual — it reports command not found, and the only state it touches is whether the simulated net-tools package has been installed. The capability is declared so the broker has something to refuse once a policy engine exists.

commands.name: test-connection
commands.notes: No packet is sent. Mirrors the shape of the real cmdlet output only.

commands.name: thc1006
commands.notes: A joke.

commands.name: traceroute
commands.synopsis: print the route packets trace to network host
commands.notes: No packet is sent. The hops are a fixed, plausible route, not a measurement.

commands.name: tree
commands.synopsis: list contents of directories in a tree-like format

commands.name: uname
commands.notes: Describes the simulated Ubuntu environment, not the machine you are using.

commands.name: uptime
commands.synopsis: Tell how long the system has been running
commands.notes: Uptime of the simulated machine, not of your computer or this tab.

commands.name: vi
commands.synopsis: Vi IMproved, a programmer's text editor

commands.name: vim
commands.synopsis: Vi IMproved, a programmer's text editor

commands.name: whoami
commands.synopsis: print effective user name, with a profile summary
